A1.justification: Both 20-page PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching the renumbered appendix figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original model-merging and compression experiments across three CLIP/ViT variants and 8-, 14- and 20-task benchmarks, with additional ablations and interference analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds compression-budget and test-time-adaptation results in Appendices D.2.6–D.2.7.

M1.justification: Appendix D.2.7 introduces an optional TSV-M variant incorporating AdaMerging-style test-time adaptation, although its mechanics are unspecified. The original TSV-C and SVD/Procrustes TSV-M procedures, including Algorithm 1, remain unchanged.

E1.justification: The same 20 classification datasets and benchmark suites are retained. The new seven-task comparison uses a subset of the existing eight-task benchmark; no new domain, population or task requirement is documented.

E2.justification: AdaMerging, previously listed only among related methods and requirements, becomes an evaluated comparator in D.2.7. Existing benchmark comparator sets remain unchanged; TwinMerging and SMILE are discussed without reported evaluations.

E3.justification: v3 adds a storage-budget sweep for ViT-L-14 on 14 tasks and a seven-task comparison with and without test-time adaptation. Existing benchmark settings remain unchanged. The seven-task membership, backbone and adaptation settings are not specified.

E4.justification: D.2.6 adds a compression-budget tradeoff analysis against TALL-Mask, and D.2.7 tests whether adaptation complements TSV-M. Existing component ablations, rank analyses and interference studies are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version specifies repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. Point-estimate reporting and the existing violin plots of layerwise approximation errors remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 2–6 are unchanged. D.2.7 newly reports 85.43% for AdaMerging, 88.93% for TSV-M and 89.87% for TSV-M with adaptation on the seven-task subset. Figure 16 adds storage-versus-accuracy results; these are additional experiments, not revisions to the original benchmark scores.

T1.justification: C.3 adds an upper bound and tightness/equality-case claims for the singular-value sum; Theorem 6.1 itself is unchanged. The new assertion that identical Ui attain sqrt(kT) is incorrect for k greater than one: their singular-value sum is k sqrt(T).

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same central compression and merging contributions, including 10-fold compression with 99% retained accuracy, interference reduction and normalized merging accuracy up to 97%.

C2.justification: New Appendix E explicitly characterizes TSV-M's motivation as empirical and STI as heuristic, and explains destructive overlaps from independent fine-tuning versus coordinated knowledge sharing. D.2.6–D.2.7 add interpretations concerning compression flexibility and adaptation complementarity.

D1.justification: Checkpoint reuse, PyTorch and hardware information, evaluation batch size, scaling-factor search, numerical stabilization and code access are unchanged. The new adaptation experiment supplies no additional implementation recipe or hyperparameters.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds TwinMerging and SMILE as SVD-based, router-dependent precedents and cites work on weight-ensembling mixtures of experts. The Model Soups explanatory paragraph is removed, but that work remains cited. Other reference changes mainly update bibliographic metadata.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized prose cuts and paragraph revisions, adds equal-contribution and funding acknowledgments, and introduces supplementary subsections and Appendix E. The main section sequence and central narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 adds Figure 16, redraws or resizes Figures 6 and 8, and relocates Figure 7. Figure 6 omits embedding entries still available in Figure 14. Captions correct blue-line descriptions to green, and the final appendix figures are renumbered.

improvement.justification: Figure 16 makes the storage/accuracy tradeoff concrete, while expanded related work and Appendix E better qualify novelty and STI's heuristic status. These provide a limited net benefit. The adaptation results are underdocumented, and C.3 introduces a false equality case, limiting the gains and weakening an ancillary mathematical claim.
